## Why visit

Worth including for the combination of cask, food and several distinct rooms in a substantial old city building. Seek out the panelled Nelson Room and the fireplace inscription recording the 1922 refurbishment; these are more informative than taking the older date on the frontage at face value. The broader world-beer offer makes it useful for a change of style on a cask-heavy afternoon. Its courtyard and room choice also make it a practical regrouping point within the dense Dale Street pub cluster.

## Beer

CAMRA lists Okell’s Bitter and Hawkshead Windermere Pale with changing cask guests; draught and bottled world beers broaden the range.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA one-star historic interior. Much of the bar furniture is later work; the building and rooms contain the strongest historic details.

**Getting there:** Dale Street close to Moorfields; convenient for Lion Tavern and Denbigh Castle.
